question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Decision'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"decision"** accurately reflects the action taken by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 1986 to change the scheduling of the Summer and Winter Games.
 
• This **decision was made to **place the Games on alternating even-numbered years, allowing for separate Winter and Summer Olympic Games.
 
• The word **"decision" **signifies a deliberate choice or determination made by the committee.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *but in accordance with a 1986 **decision** by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) to place the Summer and Winter Games on **separate** four-year cycles in alternating even-numbered years, the next Winter Olympics after 1992 was in 1994.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "precision"** refers to accuracy or exactness, but it does not fit the context of the sentence in relation to the scheduling decision.
 
• **Option 3) "indecision"** refers to a lack of decision or hesitation, which does not align with the action taken by the committee to establish a new schedule for the Games.
 
• **Option 4) "incision"** refers to a cut or surgical wound, and it does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
